column1: # Bosnian (bs) catalog, Latin script, Ijekavian. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#                                 not 12–14 | everything else), see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Bosnian computing vocabulary (sloj, maska, odabir, četkica, gradijent, zamućenje, neprozirnost
# ...). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied;
# in particular not any localisation of Adobe Photoshop. Add entries the same way. AI-assisted
# (Claude Code), not yet reviewed by a native speaker; shared with storytold/craft-i18n
# Conventions: Bosnian Latin script, Ijekavian, standard Bosnian vocabulary where the neighbouring
# languages differ (historija, sačuvaj, tačka, datoteka, postavke), sentence case. Commands are
# imperatives (Otvori…, Sačuvaj kao…), tools read "Alat …" (Alat četkica). Quotation marks „…”
# around names. Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, Camera Raw, OpenType, Lab ...) and
# RGB/CMYK stay as they are; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
